free_tier.stated: Unlimited uploads, free forever: 'Audiomack is a FREE, limitless music sharing and discovery platform'; 'Whether you have 1 song or 1,000, Audiomack lets you host it all for free. No premium creator accounts ever!'. Per-file cap 250 MB (third-party spec sheet, not vendor-confirmed).

egress.terms: Free streaming, no egress charge, no paid tier to buy.

record.tooling: Creator dashboard and mobile app; no public upload API found.
record.chaining: Unlimited tracks per free artist account x N accounts; 250 MB/track means volume needs many tracks, not large files.
record.limits_note: 250 MB per file (medium confidence. Audiohostings.com's October 2026 table, not Audiomack's own page); no published storage or bandwidth total.
record.reliability_note: Streaming-only platform: no original-file download path was found, so the payload is retrievable only as a transcode or not at all. The 'limitless' claim is about upload count, not about giving you a URL to your bytes.

evidence.proved: 'Audiomack is a FREE, limitless music sharing and discovery platform'; 'No Premium Creator Accounts - Completely Free'; 'Whether you have 1 song or 1,000, Audiomack lets you host it all for free'
Oct 2026 table: Audiomack max file size 250 MB, registration required (third-party)
